loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Decision compiler/gate must require semantic rows to map to KB/diagram updates or explicit no-KB/no-diagram-impact evidence.
Planning compiler/gate must consume KB truth and route stale/contradictory/missing semantics back to decision rather than changing KB semantics.
Implementation compiler/gate must limit KB writes to accepted non-semantic evidence/status and route new semantic meaning back to decision.
Loop source-of-truth rules must remain generic product behavior with no CodeWiki-repo dogfood special cases.

summary: Accepted loop source-of-truth ownership decision: decision owns KB, planning owns roadmap, implementation owns code/evidence.

decision_table.title: Accepted loop source-of-truth ownership decision: decision owns KB, planning owns roadmap, implementation owns code/evidence.

rows.question: KBO-000-DECISION-OWNS-SEMANTIC-KB

state_delta.current: KB update ownership can blur across decision, planning, and implementation loops.
state_delta.desired: Decision loop owns semantic KB updates: it reads canonical documentation to establish current project state, captures approved current→desired delta, updates .codewiki/kb/** and diagrams for accepted intended state, and compiles row_to_kb_mappings in the decision_build.

rows.proposed_change: Decision loop owns semantic KB updates: it reads canonical documentation to establish current project state, captures approved current→desired delta, updates .codewiki/kb/** and diagrams for accepted intended state, and compiles row_to_kb_mappings in the decision_build.
rows.rationale: The decision boundary defines semantic truth; planning should consume intended state instead of inventing it.
rows.expected_outcome: Decision loop owns semantic KB updates: it reads canonical documentation to establish current project state, captures approved current→desired delta, updates .codewiki/kb/** and diagrams for accepted intended state, and compiles row_to_kb_mappings in the decision_build.

rows.question: KBO-001-PLANNING-OWNS-ROADMAP-NOT-SEMANTICS

state_delta.current: Planning can be tempted to adjust KB semantics while decomposing work.
state_delta.desired: Planning loop owns roadmap/sprint/task/work-unit decomposition, ordering, and coverage. If KB truth is stale, contradictory, or insufficient for decomposition, planning routes back to decision instead of silently changing semantic KB.

rows.proposed_change: Planning loop owns roadmap/sprint/task/work-unit decomposition, ordering, and coverage. If KB truth is stale, contradictory, or insufficient for decomposition, planning routes back to decision instead of silently changing semantic KB.
rows.rationale: Planning is the source of work, not the source of semantic truth.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning loop owns roadmap/sprint/task/work-unit decomposition, ordering, and coverage. If KB truth is stale, contradictory, or insufficient for decomposition, planning routes back to decision instead of silently changing semantic KB.

rows.question: KBO-002-IMPLEMENTATION-OWNS-CODE-EVIDENCE

state_delta.current: Implementation may discover semantic drift while changing code/tests.
state_delta.desired: Implementation loop owns code/tests/evidence and may only write non-semantic KB evidence/status fields already covered by accepted decisions. New semantic meaning routes back to decision.

rows.proposed_change: Implementation loop owns code/tests/evidence and may only write non-semantic KB evidence/status fields already covered by accepted decisions. New semantic meaning routes back to decision.
rows.rationale: Keeps code execution from silently changing approved intent.
rows.expected_outcome: Implementation loop owns code/tests/evidence and may only write non-semantic KB evidence/status fields already covered by accepted decisions. New semantic meaning routes back to decision.

rows.question: KBO-003-GATES-ENFORCE-LOOP-OWNERSHIP

state_delta.current: Gates may not enforce KB/roadmap/code source-of-truth ownership consistently.
state_delta.desired: Decision gate blocks approved semantic rows without KB mapping or explicit no-kb-impact evidence; planning gate blocks executable accepted rows without roadmap ownership; task-close blocks code changes that leave KB/diagram/source-contract drift.

rows.proposed_change: Decision gate blocks approved semantic rows without KB mapping or explicit no-kb-impact evidence; planning gate blocks executable accepted rows without roadmap ownership; task-close blocks code changes that leave KB/diagram/source-contract drift.
rows.rationale: Gate checks make loop ownership durable and automated.
rows.expected_outcome: Decision gate blocks approved semantic rows without KB mapping or explicit no-kb-impact evidence; planning gate blocks executable accepted rows without roadmap ownership; task-close blocks code changes that leave KB/diagram/source-contract drift.

rows.question: KBO-004-GENERIC-NO-DOGFOOD-SPECIAL-CASE

state_delta.current: Self-hosting/dogfood context can tempt repository-specific source behavior for KB/roadmap ownership.
state_delta.desired: Loop ownership rules remain generic product behavior for all CodeWiki projects; repository-specific dogfood context appears only as ordinary config, KB, roadmap, runtime, and validation evidence.

rows.proposed_change: Loop ownership rules remain generic product behavior for all CodeWiki projects; repository-specific dogfood context appears only as ordinary config, KB, roadmap, runtime, and validation evidence.
rows.rationale: CodeWiki must remain distributable as a generic Pi extension.
rows.expected_outcome: Loop ownership rules remain generic product behavior for all CodeWiki projects; repository-specific dogfood context appears only as ordinary config, KB, roadmap, runtime, and validation evidence.

accepted_decisions.summary: Decision loop owns semantic KB/diagram truth updates and row-to-KB mappings.
Planning loop owns roadmap/sprint/task/work-unit decomposition and routes stale semantic truth back to decision.
Implementation loop owns source/tests/evidence and routes new semantic meaning back to decision.
No dogfood/self-hosting repository special cases in CodeWiki source.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Updated decision-to-planning flow with loop-specific source-of-truth ownership and decision-owned semantic KB clause.
Updated roadmap and flow docs to state planning owns work decomposition and routes stale semantic truth back to decision.
Updated flow docs to state implementation owns source/tests/evidence and routes new semantic meaning to decision.
Updated gateway rules to block missing decision KB mapping, missing planning roadmap ownership, and unowned implementation drift.
Docs describe generic loop ownership mechanisms rather than repository-specific dogfood behavior.

system_impact: Semantic KB ownership moves explicitly to decision loop.
Planning owns roadmap/work decomposition and cannot silently mutate semantic KB.
Implementation owns code/tests/evidence and routes semantic discoveries back to decision.
Gate rules enforce missing KB mapping, missing roadmap ownership, and unowned drift.
Generic extension behavior preserved for all projects.
propagation.no_product_impact: Clarifies internal workflow ownership and gate behavior without changing user-facing commands directly.
